node.title: E22 dyadic minimal-scale selector
node.statement: For dyadic domains, the admissible quotient moduli form a finite chain, so every canonical support-scale class with at least one admissible modulus has a unique minimal admissible modulus. Selecting that modulus gives a canonical representative of the cross-scale class.
node.attack_surface: finite-chain selector on the canonical support-scale data
node.falsifier: a dyadic canonical support-scale class with two distinct minimal admissible moduli or no well-defined selected representative
